description: Defines the internal structure and class for socket waiting using libevent, including callback handling, waitee management, and thread safety mechanisms.

classes.name: SbSocketWaiterPrivate
classes.description: Internal implementation of socket waiter using libevent, managing waitees, callbacks, and thread safety.

classes.name: Waitee
classes.description: Represents a socket registration with the waiter, including callback and interests.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a socket to the waiter with specified interests and callback.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a socket from the waiter.

methods.name: WaitTimed
methods.description: Waits for an event with a timeout.

methods.name: WakeUp
methods.description: Wakes up the waiter, optionally due to a timeout.
